note: Host config of the host.cycles live check (devloop/live-checks/host.cycles.json): the scope the retired ingest.live_sources/ingest.worker_cycles checks read, through the host's capture modules. Portal: two relations through the source mirror (persisted for outages). BC: purchaseOrders of every pinned company. SharePoint: the whole QA/QC Department (QCQA) library from its root (examples/sharepoint_capture_scope.qcqa_library.json), incremental: the first cycle walks, later cycles follow the change feed; budget_seconds bounds each cycle's capture and a walk it cuts resumes in the next cycle, so the library completes over cycles of a persistent host; the check's coverage listing has its own bound, operating/host.py CENSUS_BUDGET_SECONDS (900 s; this config sets no census_budget_seconds), never the capture's. Finance holds it through MARKING_HELD_WITH. Live check permissions.purchasing_prices_grant counts the department's members (count only).
